---
pagetitle: "Search Update Log · Proteomic GWAS Catalogue"
---

```{ojs}
catData = FileAttachment("data/catalogue.json").json()
runs = catData.search_runs
meta = catData.metadata
replacedPreprints = Array.isArray(catData.preprints_replaced) ? catData.preprints_replaced : []
```

```{ojs}
// Log page: 4 banner KPI boxes + inline-expandable log table (with preprint replacements inside each update's dropdown, no log download button)
{
  const expanded = new Set();
  const tbody = htl.html`<tbody></tbody>`;

  const replacedByPreprintId = new Map(replacedPreprints.map(p => [p.preprint_study_id, p]));

  function renderReplacedItems(rawDetails) {
    const txt = (rawDetails || "").trim();
    if (!txt) return htl.html`<span class="overlap-none">None in this update</span>`;
    const entries = txt.split(";").map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    return htl.html`<div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0.4rem;margin-top:0.25rem;">
      ${entries.map(item => {
        const m = item.match(/^(\S+)\s*->\s*(\S+)$/);
        if (m) {
          const preId = m[1];
          const pubId = m[2];
          const rich = replacedByPreprintId.get(preId);
          if (rich) {
            return htl.html`<div style="padding:0.4rem 0.55rem;background:#f8fafc;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:5px;font-size:0.78rem;">
              <div>
                <span class="mono" style="font-weight:600;">${rich.preprint_study_id}</span>
                (${rich.preprint_citation} · <a class="mono" href="https://doi.org/${rich.preprint_doi}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${rich.preprint_doi}</a>)
              </div>
              <div style="margin-top:2px;color:#166534;">
                ↳ Replaced by <span class="mono" style="font-weight:700;">${rich.published_study_id}</span>
                (${rich.published_citation}${rich.published_pmid ? htl.html` · <a class="mono" href="https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/${rich.published_pmid}/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">PMID: ${rich.published_pmid}</a>` : ""}${rich.published_doi ? htl.html` · <a class="mono" href="https://doi.org/${rich.published_doi}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${rich.published_doi}</a>` : ""})
              </div>
            </div>`;
          }
        }
        return htl.html`<div class="mono" style="font-size:0.78rem;">${item}</div>`;
      })}
    </div>`;
  }

  function renderLogRows() {
    const trs = [];
    for (const r of runs) {
      const isOpen = expanded.has(r.run_id);
      const toggle = () => {
        if (expanded.has(r.run_id)) expanded.delete(r.run_id);
        else expanded.add(r.run_id);
        renderLogRows();
      };

      const addedIds = (r.studies_added_ids || "").trim();

      trs.push(htl.html`<tr class="data-row ${isOpen ? "is-open" : ""}" onclick=${toggle}>
        <td class="mono center-col" style="font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap;">
          <span style="display:inline-block;width:12px;color:#64748b;font-size:0.7rem;">${isOpen ? "▾" : "▸"}</span>
          ${r.run_date}
        </td>
        <td class="mono center-col">${r.date_from || r.run_date} → ${r.date_to || r.run_date}</td>
        <td class="num-col"><strong>${Number(r.deduplicated_new).toLocaleString()}</strong></td>
        <td class="num-col"><span class="pg-badge data-gw">+${Number(r.studies_added).toLocaleString()}</span></td>
        <td class="num-col">${Number(r.excluded_records).toLocaleString()}</td>
        <td class="num-col"><span class="pg-badge overlap-yes">${Number(r.manual_review_required).toLocaleString()}</span></td>
        <td class="num-col">
          ${Number(r.preprints_upgraded || 0) > 0
            ? htl.html`<span class="pg-badge cur-ai-extracted">${Number(r.preprints_upgraded)} replaced</span>`
            : htl.html`<span class="overlap-none">0</span>`}
        </td>
        <td class="center-col"><span class="pg-badge ${Number(r.studies_added) > 0 ? "cur-human-reviewed" : "data-unavail"}">${r.status}</span></td>
      </tr>`);

      if (isOpen) {
        trs.push(htl.html`<tr class="detail-row">
          <td colspan="8">
            <div class="detail-topbar">
              <div>
                <p class="detail-title">Search Run <span class="mono">${r.run_id}</span> (${r.run_date})</p>
                <div style="font-size:0.78rem;color:#475569;margin-top:2px;">
                  Trigger: ${r.trigger} · Window: <span class="mono">${r.date_from || r.run_date}</span> to <span class="mono">${r.date_to || r.run_date}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div class="detail-links">
                ${r.pr_number ? htl.html`<span class="pg-badge data-unavail">${r.pr_number}</span>` : ""}
                ${r.release_tag ? htl.html`<span class="pg-badge cur-human-curated">${r.release_tag}</span>` : ""}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div class="detail-3col">
              <div class="detail-col-box">
                <h4>SEARCH PARAMETERS</h4>
                <div class="detail-kv"><strong>Databases queried:</strong> ${r.sources_queried}</div>
                <div class="detail-kv"><strong>Raw API records:</strong> ${Number(r.raw_records).toLocaleString()}</div>
                <div class="detail-kv"><strong>Unseen screened:</strong> ${Number(r.deduplicated_new).toLocaleString()}</div>
              </div>

              <div class="detail-col-box">
                <h4>SCREENING &amp; REVIEW</h4>
                <div class="detail-kv"><strong>Auto-excluded (2SMR / non-pGWAS):</strong> ${Number(r.auto_flagged_secondary_mr).toLocaleString()}</div>
                <div class="detail-kv"><strong>Total excluded:</strong> ${Number(r.excluded_records).toLocaleString()}</div>
                <div class="detail-kv"><strong>Manual review required:</strong> ${Number(r.manual_review_required).toLocaleString()}</div>
              </div>

              <div class="detail-col-box">
                <h4>CATALOGUE UPDATES</h4>
                <div class="detail-kv"><strong>Studies included (${Number(r.studies_added)}):</strong> <span class="mono">${addedIds || "None"}</span></div>
                <div class="detail-kv">
                  <strong>Preprints replaced by published studies (${Number(r.preprints_upgraded || 0)}):</strong>
                  ${renderReplacedItems(r.preprints_replaced_details)}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </td>
        </tr>`);
      }
    }
    tbody.replaceChildren(...trs);
  }

  renderLogRows();

  return htl.html`<div class="pg-shell">
    <div class="hero-banner">
      <div>
        <h1>Log</h1>
        <p>Date-stamped search update history (newest at top), including records screened, included/excluded counts, manual review queue, and preprints replaced by published studies.</p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="kpi-grid">
      <div class="kpi-card">
        <div class="kpi-label">UPDATED</div>
        <div class="kpi-value" style="font-size:1.18rem;">${meta.last_updated}</div>
        <div class="kpi-sub">Version: <span class="mono">${meta.current_version}</span></div>
      </div>
      <div class="kpi-card">
        <div class="kpi-label">DATE</div>
        <div class="kpi-value" style="font-size:1.12rem;">${meta.date_from} → ${meta.date_to}</div>
        <div class="kpi-sub">Search coverage window</div>
      </div>
      <div class="kpi-card">
        <div class="kpi-label">SCREENED</div>
        <div class="kpi-value">${Number(meta.total_screened).toLocaleString()}</div>
        <div class="kpi-sub">Total deduplicated records screened</div>
      </div>
      <div class="kpi-card">
        <div class="kpi-label">INCLUDED</div>
        <div class="kpi-value">${Number(meta.total_included).toLocaleString()}</div>
        <div class="kpi-sub">Active primary studies in catalogue</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="table-toolbar">
      <span>Showing ${runs.length} search updates (newest at top) · Click any row to expand update details &amp; replaced preprints</span>
    </div>

    <div class="cat-table-wrap">
      <table class="cat-table">
        <thead>
          <tr class="sort-row" style="cursor:default;">
            <th>DATE</th>
            <th>SEARCH WINDOW</th>
            <th>RECORDS FOUND</th>
            <th>INCLUDED</th>
            <th>EXCLUDED</th>
            <th>MANUAL REVIEW</th>
            <th>PREPRINTS REPLACED</th>
            <th>STATUS</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        ${tbody}
      </table>
    </div>
  </div>`;
}
```
